neighbours.label: friendly service reassurance addressed to a customer: what you will experience or a named helper will do for you ('will be there', 'you'll be up and running', 'was available by phone'); impersonal or institutional futures stay quiet
fire: Our stylist will be with you from the first fitting to the big day.
You'll be delighted with how fresh your carpets look afterwards.
Jenny will come out to your office and measure everything herself.
You may be pleasantly surprised by how affordable our packages are.
Our team will be right there to guide you through every step.
Tom was always available by text whenever we had a question.
You'll get a friendly call from us the day before your appointment.
Once you sign up, you'll be ready to start in just a few clicks.
quiet: The tunnel will be shut to traffic from the first of May.
The suspects will be questioned by detectives this afternoon.
Prices may be affected by the drought in the south.
The comet will be visible in the eastern sky before dawn.
The statue was moved to the museum after the fire.
Voters will get their ballots by post in early June.
The bill may be amended by the upper chamber.
Once the dam fails, the valley will be flooded within hours.

notes: Top examples peak on ' be'/' get'/' you' in promotional service text. Probing: reassurance sentences 0.20-0.40, 'will be closed/sentenced/reviewed' 0.02-0.05. Fire level is only about 0.3 of max, so the median threshold is at risk.
